description: This script generates Gitlab CI YAML configuration files for certification tests, grouping tests by variant and creating job templates with rules based on commit descriptions.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads a test file and returns a list of tests.

methods.name: read_test_files
methods.description: Reads multiple test files and returns a combined list of tests.

methods.name: sort_tests
methods.description: Sorts a list of tests alphabetically, considering numeric parts.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Extracts the base name of a test for grouping.

methods.name: get_test_groups
methods.description: Groups tests by their base name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments, reads tests, groups them, and outputs YAML configuration.
